tool_args.rationale: The gradient-sink and transient-lag signatures favor the coupled siphon-memory ODE. The five pilot rows also pair high initial memory with low gradients, making the two effects hard to separate. The fine trajectory batch adds time-resolved observations to distinguish memory relaxation from gradient-dependent forcing before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter siphon-memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoint measurements at similar horizons leave no residual degrees of freedom and can confound memory coupling with the memory relaxation time.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a Haldane or Cobb–Douglas response
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Neither static law accounts for the observed transient lag or the dependence on the initial state and memory.
